message: Scaled 2 of 3 spindle speeds to 50 %; 1 tapping speed left as written.

findings.message: S600 is the speed of a tapping block (G331). A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.
